# mcp-server-sdk-comparison

MCP Server - SDK comparison

## Install & Setup

Add to Claude Desktop config (`~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mcp-server-sdk-comparison": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-server-sdk-comparison"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Available Tools

- `compare_blockchain_sdks`
- `get_near_gas_price`
- `get_near_block_time`
- `compare_transaction_costs`
- `get_near_ecosystem_stats`

## Build from Source

```bash
npm install && npm run build
node dist/index.js
```
